senses.gloss:
The affix लोट् (Imperative) is used after a root in the sense of commanding etc.

Terms: लोट्

Also an लोट् (Imperative Mood), following after an Imperative of verbs of 'motion' retains its accent when the subject or object of both the verbs is not wholly different.

Terms: Accent

The personal endings of the लोट् (Imperative Mood) are as those of the लङ् (Imperfect Tense).

Terms: लोट् and लङ्
